newsitem.title: UK: LME people--Rudolf Wolff adds staff worldwide.
newsitem.headline: LME people--Rudolf Wolff adds staff worldwide.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) ring-trader Rudolf Wolff and Co said on Thursday it was recruiting staff for its London, New York, and Tokyo offices.
"New staff have recently been recruited to complement Rudolf Wolff's existing LME, bullion, foreign exchange, research and support operations," Wolff said in a release.

It said that Nick South and Ayman Shahin were joining from Lehman Brothers as dealers, Miguel Vargas from AIOC for Latin American marketing, Bruce Beresford from Trafigura and Kate Morris from Anglo Russian metals to complement metal finance and physical trading activities.
Kai Toshinobu, Amy Mihalakis, and Michael Christian were the other additions to staff.
Wolff, which has recently moved to new offices and introduced new information and communications technology, is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Canada's Noranda Inc. --London Newsroom 44 171 542 8080
